page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.u2i-c1m1.3xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance running on a KVM hypervisor. It is equipped with 12 dedicated Intel Xeon vCPUs operating at a clock speed of 2.7 GHz. The system configuration includes 12.0 GB of RAM, which establishes a strict memory-to-vCPU ratio of 1.0 GB per core.

This server family does not feature any local storage or GPU resources, meaning all storage requirements must be handled via external block storage. Network performance is defined by an 8 Gbps baseline bandwidth. The primary hardware tradeoff is the low memory allocation per vCPU, which limits the instance's capability to run memory-intensive applications.

From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the high density of dedicated vCPUs relative to memory makes this instance a practical option for compute-bound tasks with minimal memory footprints. Appropriate workloads include batch processing, distributed compute nodes, lightweight web serving, and CPU-bound utility services.
